name: The Sunken Crypt of Kaelen
description: A curated 3-floor SRD 5.1 dungeon campaign module taking an adventurer party from Level 1 to Level 4. Explore the ruined watchtower, navigate the bone-lined ossuary, and descend into the flooded abyssal sanctum.
author: SRD 5.1 Tactical Game Team

rooms.name: Ruined Watchtower Courtyard
rooms.description: Sunlight filters through collapsed rafters onto cracked flagstones overgrown with weeds.

rooms.name: Garrison Barracks
rooms.description: Rotting wooden cots and overturned weapon racks provide shelter to ruthless bandits.

rooms.name: Collapsed Armory Cellar
rooms.description: A damp cellar reeking of vermin. Heavy iron chests sit beneath fallen stone arches.

rooms.name: The Perilous Corridor
rooms.description: Narrow stone passage with suspicious perforations in the masonry at ankle height.

rooms.name: The Kobold Warren
rooms.description: Crude scavenging nests, scorched earth, and makeshift barricades set by vigilant kobolds.

rooms.name: The Crypt Descent Chamber
rooms.description: An ancient vaulted stone chamber leading downward into the subterranean ossuary of Kaelen.

rooms.name: Upper Landing & Crypt Antechamber
rooms.description: Chilly drafts rise from subterranean depths. Dusty stone steps lead up to the watchtower ruins.

rooms.name: Tomb of the Sentinels
rooms.description: Rows of stone sarcophagi line the walls. Skeletal guardians clutch rusted shortswords.

rooms.name: The Plague Vault
rooms.description: The stench of ancient rot hangs thick in the air. Shambling dead lurk in the shadows.

rooms.name: The Sanctified Shrine
rooms.description: A consecrated sanctuary bathed in divine radiance. Undead cannot cross the consecrated threshold.

rooms.name: The Ghoul Feeding Pit
rooms.description: Gnawed bones litter the floor around a dark depression. Feral eyes watch from the gloom.

rooms.name: Secret Reliquary of Kaelen
rooms.description: A dustless hidden chamber containing the revered weapons and scrolls of the founding knights.

rooms.name: High Ossuary of the Wight
rooms.description: Pillars carved from ossified bone support a soaring vaulted ceiling where an ancient dread lord holds court.

rooms.name: Submerged Landing
rooms.description: Black water laps gently against ancient mossy stairs leading up into the ossuary.

rooms.name: The Flooded Gallery
rooms.description: A waist-deep flooded corridor where a translucent predator dissolves debris in the sluggish current.

rooms.name: The Abyssal Ritual Chamber
rooms.description: Green braziers flicker over stone altars as fanatic cultists chant unholy invocations.

rooms.name: The Dragon's Sunken Lair
rooms.description: A cavernous flooded temple sunken beneath the earth, lair of the dreaded Young Black Dragon.
